paper_title: Direct Detection of Dark Photon Dark Matter with the James Webb Space Telescope
notes: Projection/proposal paper. The authors analyze DPDM-induced photons on the actual JWST optics (NIRSpec/MIRI) and find the contribution to the detected signal is negligible; no exclusion on epsilon can be set from real JWST as-operated. The headline upper limits epsilon ~ 1e-12 - 1e-14 over 10-500 THz at 95% C.L. (Fig. 4, red dashed 'predicted constraints') are PROJECTED SENSITIVITIES that require a modified JWST mirror configuration applied during a ground-testing phase, which 'cannot be modified' on the operational space telescope (Sec. 4 title: 'Projected Sensitivity with a Modified JWST Configuration'; Sec. 5 confirms this is projected for future missions like LUVOIR/HabEx/Origins/Roman). Fig. 5 shows model-independent 95% C.L. flux-density upper limits S_lim [Jy] from JWST data, but these are not coupling exclusions. Hence out of scope: is_projection=true, no measured limit points reported.
